descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S11 Existing spec: Hospital handoff is sent inside the app; no mailto or Email Handoff before, after or on the record

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 No email or mailto that carries patient data, on any screen that shows patient data, in Hospital and in Nursing Home: no PHI is transmitted through an unencrypted path. … (UAT OAT-02 step 3; UAT OAT-02; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress
  • U5 The handoff and the task list leave the app only through the in-app Send to a signed-in RoundCompanion recipient, never to an email address (step 3 'in app only'). (UAT OAT-02 step 3; TFA-92586 AC 6; TFA-92586 AC 7; TFA-92585 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress; TFA-92586 ready for pr; TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim's demo account with two probe patients; OTHER_USER as the colleague

When Open /rounding/handoff, wait for Send, pick the colleague, send, then open Handoffs → Sent → detail

Then No mailto: link on the sheet, after the send, or on the detail; no 'Email Handoff' button on the sheet. The send is confirmed and the record names the colleague.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions: a[href^=mailto:] toHaveCount(0) at three points (sheet, after send, detail); the Email Handoff button toHaveCount(0) on the sheet only, so the button after the send and on the detail is checked by a person in S01. Hospital only: Nursing Home is covered by S10 and S18.

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: OAT-02 Encryption Verification · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-02/S11

Existing spec: Hospital handoff is sent inside the app; no mailto or Email Handoff before, after or on the record

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-92585 Task Export (ready for pr); TFA-92586 Handoff Summary: in app (ready for pr)

Result: passed in matrix/OAT-02.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • handoff-send.spec.ts [chromium] — a handoff is sent to a colleague inside the app and recorded — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright spec e2e/handoff-send.spec.ts, chromium): it seeds the probe patients with createRoundingPatient, uses the local fixture colleague OTHER_USER and reads survey and usage rows through e2e/support/backend.ts with the local admin key; dev has no admin key, no such users and o…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
